title: sg13g2-ldo per-spec-row characterization report (T1 item 8)
purpose_and_limits: This is a CHARACTERIZATION report: one aggregated, current artifact summarizing per-row performance and citing the record behind each verdict.
Completeness is not compliance. The artifact can be complete and fresh while rows fail, are ambiguous, unmeasured or unimplemented; the envelope verdict reports artifact completeness only.
Open (unratified) targets are not passing requirements; a numeric 'pass' on an open row is a measurement against a draft target at the stated conditions.
All closed-loop numbers are SG13CMOS5L-branch evidence (DR-0007 'What evidence exists'); no closed-loop evidence exists on the SG13G2 branch.
No post-layout (extracted) performance evidence exists for any row; layout reports in layout/ are DRC/LVS/ERC and carry no performance metrics.

Row 9 (Startup) reports the explicitly selected committed startup campaign: measured failures are measured failures, missing or insufficient points are never passes, and the evaluation methodology is PROPOSED (DR-0009), not ratified. Row 9 stays Open.

Row 10 (Stability) PM/GM verdicts follow the PROPOSED margin classification DR-0014, applied offline to the selected record's committed loop-gain traces: a miss inside the sweep is a fail, a pass needs a bounded sweep ceiling, everything else stays ambiguous with its reason. Row 10 stays Open.
Other T1 items are not declared satisfied by this artifact.

selection.policy: Explicit selection only. The generator never discovers records by directory listing or filesystem order: the circuit record below is named here, its bytes are pinned by sha256, and a record that is missing or whose bytes differ from its pin is a hard generator error. Moving to a newer record is a deliberate edit to this file in the same change that regenerates the report. Historical records (other ids under sim/*/records/) are never read except where listed under superseded_evidence, and then only as a quoted, clearly-labelled statement about an older design, never as a current measurement.

design_freshness.basis: These are the design netlist hashes the selected record ran against. The record md states both sha256 values, so freshness is recorded rather than inferred. The record was made by run_sweep.sh --batch on the EDA batch fleet (issue #89) after the G1 disable pull-down changed ldo_erramp_cmos5l.spice and ldo_core_cmos5l.spice (DR-0008 addendum). It replaces 20261010-025634-60a3e81, which was current against the six-pin-amplifier netlists 7953b25b...222cc1 / 7982d728...c8e38c and is now historical. If either netlist changes, the evidence is classified stale against the design, and the envelope verdict becomes fail until a new record is selected. Record 20261011-070111-5391c68 (issue #128) re-ran the same grid on the same design netlists with only the loop-gain AC ceiling raised to 10 GHz; it replaces 20261011-051956-eda9285, which is now historical.

design_freshness.basis: The core hash is the one the campaign manifest records in source_sha256 (the generator requires the manifest value, this pin and the current file to agree). The campaign manifest does not record an error-amplifier hash, so that pin is the hash of ldo_erramp_cmos5l.spice at the time of the campaign: the campaign (issue #89) was run after the G1 disable pull-down changed that file (DR-0008 addendum), from commit df3f802, and it is the same byte content that the selected legacy circuit_record pins. It replaces 20261010-104827-91e92aa, which ran against the six-pin amplifier and is now historical. If either netlist changes the startup evidence is classified stale against the design and the envelope turns fail until a new campaign is selected.

proposed_methodology.note: Overshoot is read as peak VOUT above the +2 % band edge (1.836 V) and monotonicity as maximum downward excursion <= 1 mV before settling. 'controlled ramp' has no numeric bound in the target text and is not graded.

metrics.name: phase margin, DR-0014: minimum over every 0 dB crossing in the sweep
metrics.conditions: Vin = 3.30 V, Iload = 1 mA, Cout = 1 uF, ESR = 0, ideal 0.90 V reference; Cc nominal (MoM-cap model has no corner spread at this PDK pin); loop-gain trace 1 Hz-10 GHz, 20 points/decade (the committed bench's sweep floor and ceiling); PROPOSED classification (DR-0014), not ratified
metrics.note: Per-crossing margin = angular distance of the crossing phase from the critical point (180 deg mod 360), signed negative after an in-band encirclement. A miss inside the sweep is a fail; a pass also needs a bounded sweep ceiling (loop gain <= -10 dB and non-increasing over the last decade) and a sample bracket clear of the bound. Anything else stays ambiguous with its reason.
detail: sweep ceiling bounded at 0 of 45 points: loop gain at 10 GHz 0.3979..1.17 dB, change over the last decade -0.5642..-0.4254 dB (falling); low-end premise holds at 45 of 45

45 points have two 0 dB crossings: first-crossing margin 53.87..76.93 deg, second (rising) crossing 156.6..166.2 deg from the critical point; the record's phase_margin_worst_deg (-166.2..-156.6) is 180 + unwrapped phase, not a margin
superseded first-crossing reading (pre-DR-0014, not a verdict): 0 of 45 scored >= 45 deg, 45 unscored; range 53.87..76.93 deg

metrics.name: gain margin, DR-0014: minimum over every -180 deg crossing in the sweep
metrics.conditions: Vin = 3.30 V, Iload = 1 mA, Cout = 1 uF, ESR = 0, ideal 0.90 V reference; Cc nominal (MoM-cap model has no corner spread at this PDK pin); loop-gain trace 1 Hz-10 GHz, 20 points/decade (the committed bench's sweep floor and ceiling); PROPOSED classification (DR-0014), not ratified
metrics.note: A trace with no -180 deg crossing is never scored as a miss or as infinite margin: it passes only with a bounded sweep ceiling, which bounds the margin above the ceiling below by -(loop gain at the ceiling) >= 10 dB.
detail: superseded first -180 deg crossing reading (pre-DR-0014, not a verdict): 45 of 45 >= 10 dB, range 13.84..29.87 dB; no committed trace bounds the sweep ceiling (10 GHz), so none of these is a pass under DR-0014

notes: Cc value tolerance (ss/125C only, sim/ldo-cmos5l-pvt-sweep/records/20261011-070111-5391c68.cc-tolerance.csv): PM, GM and PSRR all hold for Cc in x0.647..x1.524 of nominal (first-crossing reading, pre-DR-0014).
